clause: Anchor + segment editing: mirroring modes, corner<->smooth, cubic-bezier drag-to-bend [STU-VEC-002,STU-VEC-003]

scope.summary: Implement the typed anchor model editing commands: per-anchor incoming/outgoing tangent handles + mirroring mode (independent / mirror-angle / mirror-angle-length), non-destructive corner<->smooth toggle preserving position + handle geometry, and cubic-bezier segments where a straight segment is the zero-length-handle degenerate case; dragging a straight segment synthesizes endpoint handles (drag-to-bend) without destroying adjacent geometry. Segments independently selectable/reshapeable as typed edits.
acceptance_criteria: mirroring modes + corner/smooth toggle + cubic segment reshape as typed non-destructive commands
expected_tests: test: mirroring modes apply as typed edits; corner<->smooth preserves position+handles; drag-to-bend converts straight->curve without altering neighbors

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No anchor/segment editing; pen/node tools have no geometry commands to drive.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
